create.name: Pir Shabda Kahn
create.bio:
Pir Shabda Kahn has led the Sufi Ruhaniat International as its Pir, or spiritual director, since 2001. The lineage runs from Hazrat Inayat Khan through Murshid Samuel Lewis, the American mystic who created the Dances of Universal Peace, and Shabda was initiated by Murshid Sam in 1970 after leaving New York, where he was born, to follow the Sufi path in California. He was later made a sheikh by Pir Vilayat Khan and in 1995 received a further initiation from Pir Hidayat Inayat Khan. For twenty-four years he studied North Indian classical singing with Pandit Pran Nath, and he directs the Chishti Sabri School of Music that carries that vocal tradition on. He is also a long-standing student of the 12th Tai Situ Rinpoche.

He teaches with gentleness and a good deal of humour, through wazifa (the recitation of divine names), zikr, silent sitting, sacred music and the Dances of Universal Peace. He is spiritual director of the Dances of Universal Peace worldwide, leads a monthly zikr circle in Novato, an annual silent Sufi sesshin in northern California and gatherings in the United States, Europe and India. He lives in San Rafael, California.

courses.title: Sufi Zikr Circle led by Pir Shabda Kahn
courses.description: A monthly evening circle in Novato, California, of Sufi chanting, song and movement led by Shabda. Open to all, with a suggested donation.

courses.title: 22nd Annual California Sufi Sesshin
courses.description: A residential retreat at The Bishop Ranch in Healdsburg, California, alternating periods of silent sitting with zikr and the Dances of Universal Peace. The aim is to join active devotional practice with meditative stillness.

courses.title: Pilgrimage to the 100th Urs of Hazrat Inayat Khan, India
courses.description: A group pilgrimage to Delhi for the centenary of Hazrat Inayat Khan's passing, with visits to Sufi shrines and the Urs celebrations at his tomb, followed by a retreat outside the city. Led by Shabda with two senior Ruhaniat teachers.

courses.title: Jamiat Aam 2027: The Living Symphony
courses.description: The Sufi Ruhaniat's international gathering, held at Camp Omega in Waterville, Minnesota, on music, sound and harmony as spiritual teachers. It includes lineage teachings, wazifa, walks, zikr and Dances of Universal Peace.

courses.title: International Camp of Dances of Universal Peace
courses.description: A five-day camp at the Sainte-Camelle ecovillage in France, guided by Shabda and Murshida Dakini Warrior, with teachings, stories, practices and the Dances of Universal Peace from the lineage of Inayat Khan and Murshid Sam.

free_resources.title: Pir Shabda's Archived Talks
free_resources.description: Free recordings of his talks, including a five-part Cambridge series on wazifa and zikr and a talk on the ninety-nine beautiful names of Allah.

free_resources.title: Monthly Messages from Pir Shabda
free_resources.description: His monthly letters to the Ruhaniat community, posted on his website.

sprint.tier_evidence: No personal YouTube, Instagram or X account linked from his site; his videos sit on others' channels; the zikr circle's Facebook group is a community group → 0 readable → local_hero
flags: No Shift mention on own site: listed without the link.

Email is the Sufi Ruhaniat International's general inbox (info@ruhaniat.org), published on ruhaniat.org, the site of the order he directs; pirshabda.org itself publishes no address (only a mailing-list sign-up).
Tier: no personal social accounts to count; as Pir of an international Sufi order he may merit a higher tier for editorial stature (owner's call).
Possible link: he is a student of the 12th Tai Situ Rinpoche (rank 420, planned as chamgon-kenting-tai-situpa).
Videos are on other people's channels (sufistories, Radio Serenidad), linked from his own Media page; 'Sufi Practice with Shabda' is a radio interview in English and Spanish.
Physicians of the Heart (a book on the 99 names of Allah he co-wrote, per third-party sources) is not on his own site, so it is left out of the bio and books.
Photos: the home-page hero (him teaching at a microphone) and the site's cropped face portrait (1200 x 630) – the same man; the first is a little soft.
Event prices are not published on his pages (the sesshin registers through a JotForm link and the India pilgrimage through a portal, not opened).
left_out: Raga offerings, choir and celebration videos on his Media page: music or ceremony recordings rather than teaching.
Open Tuning guitar class videos (2006): instrument lessons on another channel.
Talks by others on his Media page (the 12th Tai Situ Rinpoche): not his teaching.
Second zikr circle date (December 2026): same recurring item.
